prayerExcerpt.en-US: He triumphed over his torments by the patience and joy with which he suffered them for Christ.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Triunfou sobre seus tormentos pela paciência e alegria com que os sofria por Cristo.

meta.face: A Persian of about fifty with a warm, light-brown complexion and a WIDE, HEAVY-JAWED face with SQUARE, fleshy cheeks — a strong, BROAD, STRAIGHT nose with FLARED nostrils, heavy-lidded, long almond eyes that TILT DOWN at the outer corners, thick, straight black brows set LOW, a full, wide, calm mouth; black hair cut short, streaked with grey; a THICK black beard shot with grey, cut ROUNDED at the chin; the gaze calm, joyful and inward.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; Wikipedia's lead image is the book's own engraving of him kneeling at a desk. Wikipedia and the book: a rich noble of Bethlapeta, founder and abbot of a monastery, imprisoned with seven monks under Shapur II and beheaded in 376. Bethlapeta is Gundeshapur in Khuzistan (Wikipedia). The wide, heavy-jawed face with down-tilted eyes is our choice, apart from `jonas_barachisius`, the other Persian martyrs.
